row.notes: Releases the team record at index in a vector of 16-byte {allocator, ptr} slots (begin +0x08, end +0x10). Returns 0 if index is out of range or the slot is empty; if it is the last slot the vector is popped, otherwise the ptr is nulled; the record is freed through the slot allocator (vcall +0x38). Returns 1 on success. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): partial, better name Ent_SlotTable_FreeSlotByIndex: Same pattern as the vehicle variant: ushort index checked against the 16-byte-entry vector at param_1+8, tail pop or entry+8 nulling and a vtable+0x38 call on the stored pointer, returning 1/0; nothing in the code marks it as team-specific.
